# KindKey Home Buyers LLC

KindKey Home Buyers LLC is a local principal buyer (a real estate investor), not a real estate agent or broker. KindKey purchases houses directly from homeowners. The company is based at 640 1st St SW, Auburn, WA 98001.

- Website: https://kindkeyhomebuyers.com
- Main phone: (206) 519-5463
- Email: info@kindkeyhomebuyers.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=17956619195552254372
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/kindkey-home-buyers-auburn

## Service area

King County, Pierce County, and Kitsap County, Washington. Primary cities include Auburn (home office; most of the city is in King County, and some southern parcels are in Pierce County), Kent, Federal Way, Milton, Tacoma, Edgewood, Puyallup, Renton, Burien, SeaTac, Des Moines, Tukwila, Sumner, Bonney Lake, Spanaway (unincorporated Pierce County), Lakewood, Fife, Port Orchard, Bremerton, Silverdale (unincorporated Kitsap County), and Poulsbo. The full list is at https://kindkeyhomebuyers.com/areas.

## What KindKey does

KindKey buys houses as-is for cash, including houses that need repairs. KindKey does not list homes, does not charge the seller an agent commission or a separate service or assignment fee, and does not provide legal or tax advice. Sellers facing foreclosure or probate should talk with a Washington attorney. Washington has distressed-property rules under RCW 61.34; KindKey does not interpret those rules.
